reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread reply on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**. I only read that channel, after checking he's a member.

On 2025-09-03, Priyanka Sundaram posted that label printing had stalled at "Tansley Parcel depots" (plural). She said Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She later reported that Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident. Southgate is the only depot named in the channel, and there's no fuller site address.
